title: The Stadium Economy: What Does Matchday Mean for Royal Challengers Bengaluru Fans?
dek: What does a matchday at Chinnaswamy offer the people who pay to be there? The fixture list and the home record are the parts the data can measure.
excerpt: Royal Challengers Bengaluru have played their home matches at Chinnaswamy, with a home record the warehouse can measure and a fixture calendar that shapes who can attend.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: RCB have played {{ev:st-home}} matches at Chinnaswamy; since 2023 they have averaged {{ev:st-recent}} home matches a season.
They have won {{ev:st-home-win}} of decided home matches, against {{ev:st-away-win}} elsewhere.
{{ev:st-wk}} of their home matches fell on a weekend, against {{ev:st-wkl}} of all IPL matches.

sections.heading: A Short Home Season
body: A franchise sells a handful of home matches a year. Since 2023, Royal Challengers Bengaluru have averaged {{ev:st-recent}} home matches a season at Chinnaswamy, and across their history there were {{ev:st-none}} seasons with none at all.
With so few fixtures, each matchday carries a large share of the year's ticketing and hospitality opportunity.

sections.heading: What Fans See at Home
body: Royal Challengers Bengaluru have won {{ev:st-home-win}} of decided home matches, against {{ev:st-away-win}} elsewhere. Matches at Chinnaswamy produce {{ev:st-six-home}} sixes per match on average, against {{ev:st-six-other}} at other IPL venues.
A winning, high-scoring home ground is the strongest matchday offer a franchise can make.

sections.heading: When the Matches Fall
body: The fixture calendar decides who can come. {{ev:st-wk}} of Royal Challengers Bengaluru's home matches were on a Saturday or Sunday, against {{ev:st-wkl}} of all IPL matches.

sections.heading: What the Warehouse Cannot See
body: The CricField warehouse is ball-by-ball cricket data. It contains no attendance, ticket price, hospitality or concession data, so it cannot measure the commercial side of this question directly.
Measuring the stadium economy would need gate figures and spend per head by match, joined to the fixture and result data here.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Make Every Home Match Count
body: Royal Challengers Bengaluru have a limited number of home dates each year. The home record and the scoring at Chinnaswamy are the cricket side of the matchday offer.
The commercial side, pricing and experience, needs data this warehouse does not hold.
